title: SIM SEMPRO & TA (Academic Proposal & Final Project Management System)
summary: Academic capstone project built with Laravel 11, Inertia.js, React TypeScript, NLP Cosine Similarity, and Docker.
text: SIM SEMPRO & TA is a centralized academic management web platform built using a Modular Monolith architecture integrating Laravel 11, Inertia.js, React (TypeScript), and Tailwind CSS. It implements an NLP text similarity engine using N-gram tokenization and Cosine Similarity to calculate title duplication against past theses with 41.8 ms latency. Features include Topic-to-Lecturer matching, RBAC across 4 roles (Student, Lecturer, Admin, Kaprodi), 8-session guidance audit trails, Google Meet integration, 78 automated Unit/Feature tests (100% pass), SUS score 87.08 (Grade A), and Docker Compose with Cloudflare Zero-Trust Tunnel.

title: WordPress Multi-Site Cloud VPS Migration & Infrastructure Optimization (Freelance)
summary: Zero-downtime server migration of 26+ WordPress domains to Linux CloudPanel VPS with bot mitigation and performance tuning.
text: Successfully planned and executed an end-to-end zero-downtime server migration for high-traffic WordPress websites (including JatimDaily.com and 26+ client domains) from Hostinger Shared Hosting to a dedicated Linux Cloud VPS powered by CloudPanel (Nginx, PHP 8.3 FPM, MariaDB). Handled database export/import, file synchronization via rsync/SSH, custom DNS routing with local hosts bypass verification, and automated SSL/TLS provisioning. Resolved critical server bottlenecks where CPU Load Average spiked to 104+ due to aggressive AI crawlers (Meta/Claude/Exa bots) by implementing custom Nginx HTTP 403 blocking, PHP-FPM process pool tuning (pm.max_children), and Redis object caching. Reduced CPU load from 104+ to < 0.5, freed 4.5+ GB RAM, and improved TTFB from 40s+ down to 1-3 seconds. Skills: Linux (Ubuntu/Debian), Nginx, CloudPanel, WordPress, PHP-FPM, MariaDB, Redis, Bash/SSH, Server Performance Tuning, Web Security.

title: SIGNFLOW (Digital Signature & Document Verification Platform)
summary: Secure web-based digital signature and document validation platform built with Laravel, Inertia.js, React TypeScript, PWA, and MinIO.
text: SIGNFLOW is a secure web-based digital signature and document validation platform developed as a freelance project to digitize enterprise document signing workflows. Engineered dynamic PDF manipulation and cryptographic hash verification to ensure document authenticity and tamper protection. Implemented sequential multi-level approval workflows, automated queue-driven email notifications, role-based access control (RBAC), and bulk user status management with Sonner toasts. Built as a responsive Progressive Web App (PWA) supporting offline access and mobile-friendly touch signature drawing. Skills: Laravel, Inertia.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, MinIO (S3), Docker, PAdES/FPDI, Mail Queue, PWA, Sonner, Postman, Git.

title: AGGREGATOR OPERASI (Centralized Master Data Management for Toll Operations)

Established a Single Source of Truth (SSOT) architecture, built high-performance RESTful APIs with Redis caching, ensured zero-downtime legacy database backward compatibility, and structured backend with Repository and Service Layer patterns. Skills: Express.js, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Postman, Swagger, Clean Architecture, Jira.
